about: South Dundas is a municipality in Stormont, Dundas and Glengarry, Ontario, on the St. Lawrence River between Morrisburg and Iroquois—not a city. Seaway villages, Upper Canada Village nearby, and dairy farmland inland define this historic Dundas County shoreline. About 11,000 people live in South Dundas.
